provider.scope: Top 20 of RotoWire's 2026-27 Power Conference Top-200 fantasy rankings plus eight targeted players in the board's top-60 draft priority/category top-40 who also appear in the public cheat-sheet. The ranking pool covers the ACC, Big 12, Big Ten, Big East, and SEC. The article says rankings are primarily for DraftKings-scoring points leagues with G, F/C, and UTIL slots. MIN, PTS, REB, and AST are from the article's 2026-27 projection cheat-sheet table. One additional targeted omission, Rodney Rice (rank25), read October27 at12:02-12:04UTC; earliest observation and October20 publication label retained.

statusObservations.reason: Observed via RotoWire; manual review only.

statusCoverage: source evidence is partial; no status record is clearance

reference.selection: Frozen baseline normalization retained for reproducibility; corrected board ranks equal eight-category value with no positional scarcity adjustment.
reference.replacementPolicy: Frozen positional proxies retained only as provenance; not applied to corrected candidate ranks.

limitations: Per-game conditional-on-playing baseline; no season games, availability probabilities, matchup win probabilities or accuracy claim.
Eight equal standardized category contributions are a draft heuristic, not expected category wins; FG/FT use modeled attempt-weighted impact.
RotoWire ranks use a different conference/scoring scope; provider rank gaps are review flags, not proof of value. Missing provider rank means uncovered, not rejected.
Historical-only current roles, transfers, injuries and eligibility need draft-day review. Cached ADP is an unvalidated market reference.
Reconciliation candidate is review-only. The approved active board, session and Balanced strategy were not changed.
Fixed heuristic priors and weights are not fitted or calibrated. Category, normalization, minutes, prior-strength and positional scenarios are deterministic stress cases, not confidence intervals.

Verified provider fields override modeled fields where supplied and retain their original observation timestamps. Ten fresh public rows include steals, blocks and threes; missing shooting fields remain modeled. The provider-first fallback contains no statistics.
Corrected static order uses equal eight-category value without a positional replacement adjustment. The 32nd/40th/48th-player replacement scenarios are diagnostics only.
No Fantrax rank list, queue, autopick setting or live pick was changed by this reconciliation. The separately authorized October 27 import remains separate.
Sensitivity outputs are deterministic stress scenarios, not probabilities, confidence intervals, validation or an edge claim.
